How rent-to-own
makes money on a TV

lines.text: Rent-A-Center's owner sells its goods at a loss. Rent pays the bills.
lines.say: Rent-A-Center's owner sells its goods at a loss. Rent pays the bills.

lines.text: In 2025, Upbound sold goods for $829M that cost $958M.
lines.say: In twenty twenty-five, Upbound sold goods for eight hundred twenty-nine million that cost nine hundred fifty-eight million.

lines.text: Its real money: rent and fees, about 77% of revenue.
lines.say: Its real money: rent and fees, about seventy-seven percent of revenue.

lines.text: Our math: $100 of rent, minus about $40 in costs, leaves $60.
lines.say: Our math: a hundred dollars of rent, minus about forty in costs, leaves sixty.

lines.text: Only about 38% of store agreements end in ownership, per its 2024 report.
lines.say: Only about thirty-eight percent of store agreements end in ownership, per its twenty twenty-four report.

lines.text: The rest come back and go out again, often to several customers.
lines.say: The rest come back and go out again, often to several customers.

lines.text: The catch: late-2025 write-offs hit 4.9% in stores and 10.1% at Acima, its checkout lease.
lines.say: The catch: late twenty twenty-five write-offs hit four point nine percent in stores and ten point one percent at Acima, its checkout lease.

lines.text: Revenue slid from $4.58 billion in 2021, then hit $4.7 billion in 2025.
lines.say: Revenue slid from four point five eight billion in twenty twenty-one, then hit four point seven billion in twenty twenty-five.

lines.text: Acima added about $251 million of that growth.
lines.say: Acima added about two hundred fifty-one million of that growth.

post.title: Rent-A-Center's Owner Sells Goods at a Loss. Here's Why
post.ig:
Rent-A-Center's parent sold its merchandise at a loss in 2025. Rent is the business.
Upbound sold $829 million of merchandise in 2025 that cost it $958 million (a -15.5% margin).
Rentals and fees brought in $3.63 billion, about 77% of $4.7 billion in revenue; cost of rentals was 39.8% of that.
About 38% of Rent-A-Center store agreements ended in ownership (2024 10-K). Q4 2025 write-offs: 4.9% in stores, 10.1% at Acima.
Sources: Upbound Group 2025 and 2024 Form 10-K; Q4 2025 results (Feb 19, 2026).
